name: Second-Order Thinking
id_mapping: ENGINEERING_ADAPTATION: FW numeric correspondence to AG; source explicitly illustrates FW-11

source_original.purpose: Simulasi konsekuensi orde ke-2 dan ke-3 (*"And then what?"*) dari suatu keputusan dalam horizon waktu
source_original.inputs: Tindakan intervensi yang diusulkan dan respons aktor di ekosistem
source_original.outputs: Pohon dampak berantai (Horizon 1: 0–3 bln, Horizon 2: 3–12 bln, Horizon 3: >1 thn)

activation_conditions: User requests Second-Order Thinking or the orchestrator justifies it against the problem.
methodology: Ask And then what for actor responses and feedback across second and third orders
Separate near, medium and long horizons
Identify countervailing effects, leading indicators and reversible probes
tool_requirements: Host reasoning and resource reading; calculation tool when required.
evidence_requirements: Cite material claims; mark missing inputs UNKNOWN; do not reuse illustrative source conclusions.
limitations: Host-authored analysis requires behavioral evaluation; schema validity does not prove truth.
validation_criteria: Provide consequence_tree or declare it UNKNOWN with reason.
Provide uncertainties or declare it UNKNOWN with reason.
Provide indicators or declare it UNKNOWN with reason.
Use all distinctive methodology steps and identify missing evidence.
